reply_text:
I saved Hollis's note in gbrain: their dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups is Gate 40 from now on. I also confirmed it to them in a threaded reply in their direct message.

My first save went in as "world," so everyone could have seen it, even though I set it to private. Because Hollis told me this in a direct message, I saved it again as private and expired the first one. Only the private copy is still active. Expiring the first one keeps its audit record.
